validator_question: Does 🔒📜 LOCK_LOCAL in CONQUESTLAND conflict with kernel LOCK mechanics?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — LOCK is shared vocabulary; CONQUESTLAND LOCK = temporal freeze only, not governance lock
